name: Sales — event attendee
description: Uses a shared event as the reason to exist. Works before the event ("are you going?") and after ("what did you make of it?"). Written for the after case, which converts better.
audience: Lists built from `event.attendees`, a conference badge scan, or a webinar registration export.

variants: {{firstName|Hi}} — we were both at the same event and didn't manage to speak. Fixing that here. Connecting, no agenda.
Hi {{firstName|there}} — saw you on the attendee list. Would rather connect properly than let another conference pass without it.
Thanks {{firstName|there}}. What did you actually take away from it? I came out convinced everyone has the same problem and nobody wants to say so on a panel.
Good to connect, {{firstName|there}}. Was any of it useful to you, or was it the usual? I got more out of the corridors than the stage.
{{firstName|Hi}} — the recurring theme for me was how much of this is still done by hand. Is that the picture at {{company|your company}} too?
One thing that stuck with me, {{firstName|there}}: nobody had solved the manual part. Curious whether {{company|your team}} has.
I'll leave it there, {{firstName|there}} — good to have met you on paper at least. See you at the next one.
Signing off, {{firstName|there}}. If you're at the next one, find me — the corridors are better than the panels.
